Ever thought you’d see Git being replaced? 👀

May 2026: ~2,500 PRs/day
Sep 2026: 30,000 PRs/day

That’s 12x growth in just 4 months. 🤯

The reason? AI agents. Anthropic is running them at massive scale.

And that’s where Git started to struggle:
→ So many pulls = network traffic spikes
→ Storage space becomes a constraint

So a team of 7 engineers built a brand new system, plus a completely separate code review system.

But don’t get it wrong, Git is NOT dead. ❌
For our day-to-day tasks, Git is still right there. The new system is built to handle massive AI scale.
